content.text:
There is nothing wrong with this account, and no refund is owed.

Arjun has two payments because he made two purchases. Payment 201 of ₹999 on 2 June settled against ORD-1876, the annual Pro renewal. Payment 202 of ₹1,499 on 11 August settled against ORD-2340, five extra seats. Two orders, two amounts, seventy days apart.

This is a repeat purchase and not a duplicate charge, so I am not opening a ticket and there is nothing for a colleague to review. If the two entries on his statement are still confusing, they are the June renewal and the August seat upgrade.
